follow-up time: Duration of hospital stay after planned cesarean section
exposure: Interpersonal interactions between patients and hospital staff
outcome: Feasibility of continuous video recording of patient-staff interactions
cohort: 12 women admitted to a postnatal unit after planned cesarean section at 37+ weeks gestation with no known medical or obstetric complications.
finding: Continuous video recording of patient-staff interactions in a postnatal unit is feasible and can provide both quantitative and qualitative data, but may encounter contextual barriers related to staff engagement.
